              const googletag = (window.googletag = window.googletag || { cmd: [] });

              function createUuid() {
                if (window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
                  return window.crypto.randomUUID();
                }
                return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function (char) {
                  const rand = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
                  const value = char === 'x' ? rand : (rand & 0x3) | 0x8;
                  return value.toString(16);
                });
              }

              function assignNewAdIdOnSlot(slot) {
                if (!slot || typeof slot.setTargeting !== 'function') return;
                try {
                  slot.setTargeting('ad_id', createUuid());
                } catch (error) {
                  console.error('Failed to set ad_id targeting on slot', error);
                  try {
                    slot.setTargeting('ad_id', createUuid());
                  } catch (e2) {
                    console.error('Retry set ad_id on slot failed', e2);
                  }
                }
              }

              function findSlotByElementId(pubads, divId) {
                if (typeof divId !== 'string' || typeof pubads.getSlots !== 'function') return null;
                const slots = pubads.getSlots();
                for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
                  if (slots[i].getSlotElementId() === divId) return slots[i];
                }
                return null;
              }

                if (typeof googletag.pubads !== 'function') return;
                const pubads = googletag.pubads();
                if (!pubads) return;

                if (typeof googletag.display === 'function') {
                  const originalDisplay = googletag.display.bind(googletag);
                  googletag.display = function () {
                    const arg0 = arguments[0];
                    if (arg0 && typeof arg0.setTargeting === 'function') {
                      assignNewAdIdOnSlot(arg0);
                    } else {
                      const slot = findSlotByElementId(pubads, arg0);
                      if (slot) {
                        assignNewAdIdOnSlot(slot);
                      }
                    }
                    return originalDisplay.apply(googletag, arguments);
                  };
                }

                if (typeof pubads.refresh === 'function') {
                  const originalRefresh = pubads.refresh.bind(pubads);
                  pubads.refresh = function (slots, options) {
                    const slotsToRefresh = slots || (typeof pubads.getSlots === 'function' ? pubads.getSlots() : []);

                    slotsToRefresh.forEach(function (slot) {
                      assignNewAdIdOnSlot(slot);
                    });

                    if (slotsToRefresh.length === 0) {
                      return;
                    }

                    return originalRefresh(slotsToRefresh, options);
                  };
                }
              });
